metas.name: Migration
metas.description: Features a family of ducks on an exciting adventure, similar to the animal adventures in Rio and Zootopia.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A hilarious and action-packed animated adventure about a quirky family, echoing the comedic and family-focused themes of Ratatouille and Encanto.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A magical animated adventure with songs and a strong protagonist, similar to the fantasy and adventure elements in Tangled and Brave.

metas.name: Puss in Boots
metas.description: The original adventure of the charming feline hero, offering more of the fantasy and swashbuckling fun seen in Puss in Boots: The Last Wish.

metas.name: Shrek 2
metas.description: Continues the hilarious fairy tale parodies and character-driven humor of the first Shrek.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: An exciting animated adventure about a super-powered family, with action and humor appealing to fans of adventure and comedy.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A heartwarming animated adventure about an unlikely friendship between a boy and a dragon, with beautiful animation and themes of acceptance, similar to fantasy adventures.

metas.name: Moana
metas.description: An epic animated musical adventure with a strong female lead and a journey across the ocean, reminiscent of the adventurous spirit of Tangled and Brave.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A heartwarming animated superhero adventure with a focus on friendship and problem-solving, fitting the adventure and family-friendly criteria.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A charming live-action comedy about a polite bear who finds a new home, with gentle humor and adventure similar to family comedies.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Even more delightful and heartwarming than the first, offering more of the gentle comedy and adventure.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: A groundbreaking animated adventure with incredible visuals and a compelling story, appealing to fans of animation and adventure.

metas.name: Vivo
metas.description: An animated musical adventure about a kinkajou traveling from Havana to Miami, featuring catchy songs and a heartwarming journey, similar to Rio and Sing.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A charming animated film about two young sea monsters experiencing a summer of adventure on the Italian Riviera, with themes of friendship and discovery.

metas.name: Klaus
metas.description: A visually stunning animated origin story of Santa Claus, filled with heart and humor, appealing to fans of family comedies and unique animation.

metas.name: Trolls
metas.description: A vibrant and musical animated adventure with a positive message, similar to the musical and comedic elements of Sing and Encanto.

metas.name: Trolls World Tour
metas.description: Continues the colorful and musical adventures of the Trolls with new genres and challenges, keeping the fun and music alive.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: A wildly creative and funny animated adventure with a great message about originality, fitting the comedy and adventure genres.

metas.name: The Lego Batman Movie
metas.description: A hilarious and action-packed spin-off that parodies Batman with great humor, appealing to fans of comedy and adventure.

metas.name: Fantastic Mr. Fox
metas.description: A visually unique stop-motion animated film with witty dialogue and a charming adventure, in the vein of Wes Anderson's distinct style.

metas.name: The Willoughby's
metas.description: A quirky and funny animated adventure about four siblings who plan to abandon their neglectful parents, offering a unique take on family and adventure.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A visually spectacular animated musical fantasy adventure about a girl who builds a rocket to travel to the moon, with themes of love and loss.

metas.name: Ron's Gone Wrong
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy about a boy and his malfunctioning robot, exploring themes of friendship and technology in a humorous way.

metas.name: Mitchells vs. Machines
metas.description: A modern animated family adventure with excellent humor and relatable characters facing a global robot apocalypse, similar to how the Super Mario Bros. movie brought its world to life.

metas.name: Paws of Fury: The Legend of Hank
metas.description: An animated action-comedy with a samurai dog protagonist, offering humor and adventure that fans of Kung Fu Panda might enjoy.

metas.name: Despicable Me
metas.description: A funny and heartwarming animated comedy about a supervillain who adopts three orphaned girls, introducing memorable characters and humor.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: Continues the adventures of Gru and his adopted daughters with more humor and Minion antics.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A fun prequel focusing on the beloved yellow characters and their quest for a villain to serve.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A prehistoric animated adventure comedy about a family of cavemen who embark on a journey, offering humor and exploration.

metas.name: The Croods: A New Age
metas.description: Continues the journey of the Croods as they encounter a more advanced family, with plenty of humor and adventure.

metas.name: Turbo
metas.description: An animated underdog story about a garden snail who dreams of becoming the fastest racer in the world, with humor and inspiration.

metas.name: Home
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy adventure about an alien who befriends a human girl, featuring catchy music and a heartwarming story.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A wildly imaginative and funny animated film about an inventor whose machine creates food from the sky, full of visual gags and adventure.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
metas.description: Continues the food-filled adventures with even more creative and delicious-looking creations.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A witty and humorous animated superhero film that flips the script on typical villain narratives, offering smart comedy and action.

metas.name: Arthur Christmas
metas.description: A charming and humorous animated film about how Santa delivers presents, with a focus on family and ingenuity.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: An inventive animated adventure that explores the world of arcade games, featuring fun characters and a compelling story.

metas.name: Ralph Breaks the Internet
metas.description: The sequel to Wreck-It Ralph, expanding the adventure into the internet with new challenges and friendships.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 2
metas.description: Continues the action-packed and humorous adventures of Po, with more martial arts and character development.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Po trains a village of pandas, leading to more fun, action, and heartwarming moments.
